'''Whuvumm''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] and proprietor of the [[Jungle Vault]], an underground [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]].

The Ithorian name Whuvumm was believed to mean "bread maker".<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
